reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lyssa Goldberg
reviewSamples.text: We're so glad to have found an electrical contractor we can trust with taking care of our home. Leandro and his team have now helped us with various projects, including hardwiring a bathroom mirror over a tile wall and installing a new wall outlet. Leandro is very professional, communicative, and patient when it comes to answering questions and giving explanations. He's even helped us solve small problems in the middle of visiting for a free estimate. We look forward to working with them again

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Shirley
reviewSamples.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had an excellent experience with Leandro. He was the very first electrician to respond to our service request on Yelp, and he replied incredibly quickly.
From the beginning, he provided personalized attention, communicated clearly, and honored every commitment and timeline he promised. His professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail immediately gave us confidence that we had chosen the right person for the job.
The price he quoted was fair, reasonable, and well worth the quality of the work performed. The job was completed efficiently and to a very high standard. In fact, Leandro exceeded our expectations in every way.
It is not always easy to find a licensed electrician who combines expertise, responsiveness, honesty, and excellent customer service, but Leandro truly does. We highly recommend him without hesitation and have already added him to our list of trusted professionals. Whenever we need electrical work in the future, he will be our first call.
Thank you, Leandro, for the outstanding service!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Danny Velasquez
reviewSamples.text:
Leandro of America Power Electric was a true professional. After a quick analysis of the two projects we had for him, he went right to work and completed the installations exactly how we had hoped for.

He was on time, knowledgeable, kept a clean workspace and also offered some insight into a few additional projects that we would like to complete in the home.  He has instantly become our go to electrician.  Highly recommended!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mauricio Tijerino
reviewSamples.text: Amazing electrician! Very professional and ethical. Resolved the problem with my generator not providing enough power to the house. Leo went above and beyond to fix the problem. Very fair fees as well.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Michael
reviewSamples.text: Leandro was fantastic from start to finish. He reviewed my issue, answered questions and provided an estimate over the phone as able, was very accommodating with my schedule, and arrived early with a text message update on his arrival time. He was professional and completed the work quickly and skillfully, and had a very fair price. I talked to him about some other projects I may want to do, and will definitely use him again in the future! Would recommend to anyone!
